product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global helps businesses manage domestic and international supply chains through logistics, cargo transportation, trade consulting, and GlobalLink shipment tracking and reporting.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found; the company directs visitors to request a transportation quote.

named_customers.notes: Case studies identify Umbra as a Customs Brokerage client and Frazer & Jones as an inbound transportation client.

employee_band.notes: Company-size range reported on its LinkedIn profile.

hq_location.notes: The company describes its headquarters as Syracuse, New York.

eng_blog.notes: The Knowledge Center covers trade regulations, logistics, market updates and company news, rather than engineer-authored articles about building software.

public_docs.notes: The public GlobalLink API portal documents authentication and numerous operations for bookings, containers, shipments, events, documents and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists 31 openings, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named AI model or provider was found in the public API documentation, AI-related company article, Knowledge Center, or privacy and legal pages; no dedicated AI FAQ or named subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages name none of the five specified certifications or compliance frameworks.

last_funding.notes: No publicly recorded outside funding rounds were found; this does not establish that the company is bootstrapped.

raised_18mo.notes: No publicly recorded outside funding was found, including during 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive (Domestic 3PL) position in Cheektowaga, New York, is listed with an application link; the board also lists other Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying public launch announcement was found for 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. The MGCX expansion announcement is dated December 4, 2025; the recent GlobalLink case study describes a custom client deployment, not a generally available feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No join or departure during 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09 was identified after reviewing the 13-person executive roster and available profiles; some profiles omit start dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Sales Manager posting explicitly requires Salesforce discipline and management through CRM data.
